there is no conclusive evidence for any integrative approach in breast cancer treatment, but there is evidence that some of them may be useful.

there is a need for further research to determine the efficacy of integrative approaches in breast cancer treatment.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

the use of dietary and lifestyle interventions, and selected supplements and integrative modalities can improve quality of life and at times improve outcomes in patients undergoing conventional treatment for early-stage breast cancer.

women who have breast cancer can use integrative approaches safely and effectively.
integrative approaches can be helpful in managing the symptoms of breast cancer and its treatment.
